newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAA says car rack service exceeds forecasts.
newsitem.headline: SAA says car rack service exceeds forecasts.

text.p: South African Airways said on Tuesday demand for its car rack service for transportation of vehicles between Cape Town and Johannesburg launched in August was beyond expectations.
SAA executive manager Charles Fairweather said the service was introduced by SAA Cargo and flights were fully booked until the end of January.
"It has proved to be so successful that we are fully booked until the end of January both on the passenger flights and the freighters," Fairweather said in a statement.
